items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Wendell was interviewed at the Los Angeles Classic Jazz Festival on September 3, 1995 by Michael Woods.

ctx.x: Wendell Brunious’ trumpet and flugelhorn are a welcome addition to many festivals around the country. Wendell grew up playing Dixieland in his home town of New Orleans and he is comfortable in a variety of jazz settings, including the college classroom. In the first part of the interview, Wendell and his friend trombonist Dan Barrett share a conversation.
Wendell was interviewed at the Los Angeles Classic Jazz Festival on September 3, 1995 by Michael Woods. Monk Rowe was also present for the interview.
Well I guess we’re on camera. My name is Dan Barrett and I’m privileged and honored to introduce a very good friend of mine and a terrific trumpet player from New Orleans, Mr. Wendell Brunious.
